treatment.estimand: marginal proximal intention-to-treat effect of the current randomized BWE ratio, averaged over factual histories generated by the probe's earlier IID assignments

outcomes.name: actual_payload_ratio
outcomes.units: actual pre-RTP encoded payload rate divided by the BWE used at assignment

outcomes.name: on_time_share
outcomes.units: percentage-point change in requests read back within the probe's fixed 150 ms criterion

estimator.covariance: peer-clustered CR1 sandwich; t reference with 15 degrees of freedom
estimator.p_adjustment: Holm across all six two-sided outcome/contrast tests

claim_limits: The data and analyses are native-stack factual evidence on owned procedural content over one machine and TURN/TCP; they do not validate the older UDP pilots or real networks.
This post-capture analysis is exploratory and uses only 16 peers, four scene seeds and two authored schedules.
The one-step delivery metric is not human QoE, selected-policy calibration, a state-conditioned action-value model, episode safety, or controller qualification.
No model, counterfactual outcome, source selection, or controller promotion is permitted by this analysis.
